<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5a5b248 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="5a5b248" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="heading.default">

## Plumbers in Arcadia, Brea & Upland Since 1981.

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b836bae elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b836bae" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="text-editor.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

Western Rooter & Plumbing is a family-owned plumbing and rooter company that has served [Arcadia](https://westernrooter.com/regions/arcadia/), [Brea](https://westernrooter.com/western-rooter-opens-new-brea-ca-location-for-24-7-emergency-plumbing/), [Upland](https://westernrooter.com/local-expert-tips-how-to-choose-a-reliable-plumber-near-me-in-upland/), and surrounding San Gabriel Valley communities since 1981. What started as a small family operation in Monterey Park has grown into one of the region’s most trusted local plumbing companies, built on honest work, fair pricing, and dependable service.

Our licensed and insured plumbers provide full-service [residential](https://westernrooter.com/services/residential-plumbing/) and [commercial plumbing](https://westernrooter.com/services/commercial-plumbing/), including drain cleaning, sewer repairs, leak detection, water heater services, installations, and emergency plumbing. Whether it’s a routine repair or an urgent plumbing issue, our team is available 24/7 to keep your home or business running safely and efficiently.

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

At Western Rooter & Plumbing, we’re proud to offer expert plumbing services from three easily accessible locations, [Arcadia](https://westernrooter.com/regions/arcadia/), [Brea](https://westernrooter.com/regions/brea/), and [Upland](https://westernrooter.com/regions/upland/), ensuring faster response times and more efficient service throughout Los Angeles and San Bernardino Counties. Whether you’re closer to our Arcadia office at 136 E. Santa Clara Street or our Upland location at 1551 W. 13th St, Suite 307, our licensed professionals are ready to help with everything from emergency plumbing repairs to routine drain cleaning. Call the location nearest you and experience the Western Rooter difference today!

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

We are the [trenchless sewer line repair and replacement](https://westernrooter.com/the-pros-and-cons-of-trenchless-sewer-repair/) experts for commercial plumbing needs. With cutting-edge technology, we provide efficient and non-invasive solutions for your sewer line problems, minimizing disruption to your business. Our trenchless methods allow us to repair or replace underground pipes without the need for extensive digging, saving time and costs. Whether it’s a large industrial facility or a <a href="https://westernrooter.com/whats-the-real-cost-per-foot-for-replacing-your-sewer-line/" style="background-color: rgb(247, 249, 255);">multi-unit complex</a>, we handle it all with expertise and professionalism. Trust us to keep your plumbing systems flowing smoothly, backed by our 24/7 <a href="https://westernrooter.com/services/24-hour-emergency-plumber/" style="background-color: rgb(247, 249, 255);">emergency plumbing</a> and free estimates.

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8950e62 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="8950e62" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="heading.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

## Same-Day & Emergency Plumbing Services We Offer:

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d6354a3 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d6354a3" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="text-editor.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

Customer service is everything to us at Western Rooter & Plumbing. When you contact us for emergency plumbing services, you can rest assured knowing we’ll be on our way to take care of your plumbing needs as soon as possible. Whether you have water leaking from your kitchen sink, a massive clog in your sewer line, or your toilet is backing up, we’ve got you covered.

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-bd56f40 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="bd56f40" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="heading.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

### All the plumbing services you need from one place...

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f205df4 elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="f205df4" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="text-editor.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

Your plumbing system is complex and requires different types of technology for [drain cleaning](https://westernrooter.com/services/drain-cleaning/), [backflow testing](https://westernrooter.com/services/backflow-testing/), [trenchless sewer repair](https://westernrooter.com/services/trenchless-sewer-pipe-repair/), and more. Fortunately, Western Rooter & Plumbing is a full-service plumbing company that provides a wide range of services to keep your plumbing system in great shape. We perform drain cleaning services, hydro jetting, backflow testing, trenchless sewer repair, gas leak detection and repair, and sewer camera inspections. We also install [whole house water filtration systems](https://westernrooter.com/faqs/whole-house-water-softener-installations-faq/) and water heaters.

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2cbff46 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="2cbff46" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="heading.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

### Your one-stop local plumber...

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

Don’t worry about having to search for different plumbing services to make different repairs. Contact Western Rooter & Plumbing to get all your plumbing repairs, replacements, and installations done in one place. To learn more about our [plumbing services](https://westernrooter.com/services/) or to schedule an appointment with us, contact Western Rooter today.

</div>

</div>

We are your go-to plumbers for all your plumbing needs, from simple repairs to brand new installation projects. On top of being local, friendly, and a powerhouse authority within the plumbing industry, we are also known for being among the most affordable plumbers in Southern California. Our dedicated team of professionals can handle all your plumbing needs – big or small!

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-55e782b elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="55e782b" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="heading.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

## Expert Plumbing Services Across Los Angeles, Orange, and San Bernardino Counties

</div>

</div>

<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a931fdd elementor-widget__width-initial elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="a931fdd" element_type="widget" e-type="widget" widget_type="text-editor.default">

<div class="elementor-widget-container">

Western Rooter & Plumbing is a family-owned plumbing and rooter company based in Arcadia, California and proudly serving communities across Los Angeles County, Orange County, and San Bernardino County. Since 1981, our licensed plumbers have helped homeowners and businesses with drain cleaning, sewer line repairs, leak detection, water heater service, and emergency plumbing. While our headquarters is in Arcadia, our team provides fast, reliable plumbing services throughout the San Gabriel Valley, Inland Empire, and surrounding areas. Explore the service areas below to find professional plumbing help near you.

</div>

</div>

</div>
